content.introduction: Inflation data includes annual and monthly rates for the U.S. Consumer Price Index, with key metrics like year-over-year changes and annual rates. The data spans from 1960 to 2026, with updates as recent as July 2026. The Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis provides this comprehensive economic data series.
